cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded my walking-club rejection like your note. Just the decision showing. Hand me yours; I want the reason.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I folded this to hide another applicant's address. I can read your bit to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Addresses covered, certainly. I want to see the actual sentence, not hear your version.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The next paragraph's about that other applicant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fold that back too. Let me read just the line about me.
